headline: Official Announcement: Huawei and Seres Adjust Cooperation Model, AITO Brand to Be Exclusively Operated
summary: Huawei and Seres announced an adjusted cooperation model under which the AITO brand will be exclusively operated. The announcement covers automobiles and smart driving.
why: Seres is a Chinese automaker that has partnered with Huawei on AITO-branded electric vehicles. Changes to such partnerships affect the strategy and sales outlook of both firms in China's EV market.
